title: Regional debenture borrowing approved at special meeting
subtitle: Closed session on a potential land acquisition; no delegations; quick meeting adjourned at 10:13 a.m.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting on June 4, 2024 to consider advice on a potential land acquisition and to pass a borrowing by-law. Council met in closed session for legal advice on the possible acquisition of lands. No items were reported out of that session, so no decision on the land has been made public.

Council then passed By-law 24-022, which authorizes $40,000,000 in instalment debentures for Regional capital works. The debentures are split across five, ten and fifteen year terms. Council also received a staff report on the debenture issue dated June 7, 2024, for information. Debentures are a way the Region finances capital projects such as infrastructure over time, so this borrowing shapes the Region's debt commitments in coming years.

There were no delegations and no declarations of interest. The meeting wrapped up quickly and adjourned at 10:13 a.m. The by-law to confirm proceedings was removed because there were no items to confirm.

decisions.detail: Council passed a by-law authorizing $40,000,000 in instalment debentures with five, ten and fifteen year terms to fund capital works of the Region.

debate: The transcript records no substantive debate or delegations; the Chair noted that staff, including the Acting Commissioner of Corporate Services, were available for questions on the debenture report.
No questions were raised on the debenture issue, and the related by-law moved to a vote without discussion.
One councillor remarked that all council meetings should be carried out as expeditiously as this one.
Closed-session discussion was limited to the publicly stated purpose of receiving legal advice on a potential land acquisition.
